name: Devin Max

meters.label: Daily quota
meters.hint: Devin Desktop status bar → Plan Info, or app.devin.ai/settings/usage

reset.rule: Resets each calendar day. Devin doesn't say at what time or in which time zone.
stipulations: Measured in tokens at each model's price, so expensive models drain it faster.
Free models don't count. SWE-2 is free in Devin Desktop and CLI until 30 Nov, and SWE-2 Flash until 4 Dec.
Tab completions and inline edits are unlimited and don't count.
The daily quota is a little more than 1/7 of the weekly quota.

meters.label: Weekly quota
meters.hint: Devin Desktop status bar → Plan Info, or app.devin.ai/settings/usage

reset.rule: Resets weekly by calendar date. Devin doesn't say which day or time.
stipulations: A request needs room in both the daily and the weekly quota.
Fast mode costs 2x on Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-5.6 Sol.

overage: At the limit you wait for the reset, switch to a free model, or buy extra usage. Extra usage is a prepaid USD balance billed at API list prices, and the quota never caps it. It's off until you buy some. Purchased credits don't expire.

how: Daily and weekly token quotas, spent at each model's price. Much larger than Pro.
Devin's estimate for Max: 42 to 170 messages a day on the priciest models, 291 to 1,190 on lightweight ones.
ext: Claude, GPT, Gemini and open models spend the quota at their API prices.
External agents over ACP (Claude Agent, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) run in Devin Desktop and bill through your own account with that provider.
The Windsurf JetBrains plugin is in maintenance mode. Cognition suggests running Devin over ACP in JetBrains instead.
quirks: Windsurf became Devin Desktop on 2 June 2026. The app is now Devin.app or Devin.exe, so allowlists for the old binary need updating.
The old prompt credits are gone. Leftover add-on credits became extra usage balance, refundable through support.
SWE-2 is free in Devin Desktop and the CLI but not in Devin cloud sessions.
Devin publishes no quota sizes, only estimated messages per day.
Max has no daily cap, only the weekly one (third-party report, unconfirmed).
card.alert: Ends 30 Nov 2026: SWE-2 stops being free.

events.what: SWE-2 stops being free in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI.
SWE-2 Flash stops being free at 18:00 UTC. Then $0.10 per 1M input tokens.
Gemini 3.7 and 3.8 Flash intro pricing ($0.75 in, $3.75 out per 1M tokens) ends.
